reviews.title: Fresh and fun
reviews.text: A "must" in Lima to enjoy many of the great classics of Peruvian cuisine.  Reservations are not allowed. We have to wait. Wait, it'll be worth it.

reviews.title: Best Cevicheria! Totally worth the wait!
reviews.text: Delicious. When we got there, we were told the wait time was 2 hour. It actually ended up being longer. We ended up taking an uber from there to the beach front walking area which was a good idea! highly recommend doing that if the wait is long when you get on the waiting list. The food was delicious and the service was amazing once we were seated! Even our two kids thought the food was amazing and worth the wait!
reviews.review_tip: Get there as close to opening time as possible. We were told the wait time would be 2 hours. We ended up taking an uber and enjoyed Miraflor

reviews.title: Nice atmosphere and wonderful food
reviews.text: Wonderful restaurant, super careful and quick service. Everything we experienced was excellent!!! Super recommend

reviews.title: Delicious fresh seafood!!
reviews.text: Out of this world delicious ceviche clásico and octopus À la Brasa! We are coming back to explore more of the menu. So so good!!

reviews.title: Modern Peruvian Cuisine
reviews.text: Great ceviche, excellent cocktails and attentive service. The waterfront setting adds a relaxed and elegant touch to the dining experience.

reviews.title: Worth how much it weighs
reviews.text: Everything perfect, from the care to the dishes. We ate a kind of shrimp moqueca that wasn't on the menu we saw on Instagram wonderful and the dessert was the best of our lives. Churros fried full of ice cream and wonderful fruits

reviews.title: Late, folks.
reviews.text: The best seafood in the country without a doubt. From the entrance you are greeted with great friendliness and both food and service are TOP

reviews.title: Good ceviche
reviews.text: The ceviche is fresh and tastes very good, the portions just right and the Mood always lively. Sometimes you have to wait a while to get a table and the Service can delay when it is full, but it is worth it for the Quality of food. The prices are a little high, although according to experience. Overall, a very good place to enjoy seafood and Peruvian food in a relaxed Mood.

reviews.title: Cebiche Central
reviews.text: Lively Miraflores spot where ultra fresh cebiche, tiraditos and a sharp pisco sour lead the show service is quick, portions are shareable, and a daytime reservation helps come hungry and start with the clasico.

reviews.title: GREAT RESTAURANT
reviews.text: We have eaten at La Mar Cebichería as a first introduction in Lima, and there is no better way to introduce yourself to good Peruvian food, all excellent, very well served by Juan José Ruiz.

reviews.title: A cuilinary experience you won't forget
reviews.text: Great food and service, convenient to Miraflores hotels. They're one of the few good restaurants open on a Sunday and don't require a reservation (they don't take them at all; as a result the wait times are long). Popular with the locals as well as tourists. I recommend the Causa Limena as an entree and the chocolate cake for dessert (made with chocolate from 3 different regions in Peru), with maybe an empanada for an appetizer. Sharing (para compartir) is acceptable.
reviews.review_tip: The menu is a la carte, so you don't have to spend $200-300 per person for a good meal.

reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.text: Whenever you go to sea, apart from trying fresh things at their best, the cooking technique is impressive, I will not tire of visiting them

reviews.title: Highly overrated
reviews.text: Way overated, do not live up to the hype, the last 3 time I not been happy and decided I not give it anymore changes. Don't let you fool of signs hanging in the bar 50best resturant it as far as I now never been on the list and it's falls appertize. If you want good fish the Peruvian way even for a great price head to PuntoAzul

reviews.title: A jewel of Peruvian cuisine
reviews.text:
We stayed at La Mar Cebichería in Lima and the experience was spectacular. The friendly atmosphere, professionalism and kindness of the staff won us over. The quality of the dishes is very high, from ceviche to pasta with hedgehogs, from soups to desserts, all balanced and surprising.
A restaurant that combines tradition and creativity under the guidance of the great chef Gastón Acurio, a true ambassador of Peruvian cuisine. Absolutely not to be missed in Lima!

reviews.title: Best fish/seafood in Lima
reviews.text: Fantastic fish and seafood place. The atmosphere is relaxed and the staff very attentive and helpful. We chose the tasting menu, which was entirely about sea urchins: 13 courses, all delicious. The tasting menu was not cheap but the price/quality ratio was excellent. Ceviche was much cheaper. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Mandatory visit
reviews.text: If you want to taste the good taste of fish on the coast after an inland trip, coming to the Sea is mandatory. The hard part is going to be choosing what to eat from everything they offer. In our case we chose the trio of cebiches and we loved it. There is a wide variety of fresh fish and they have special dishes according to season. Mood is relaxed and good vibes are generated with the music. The price is high but correct for what they offer. Good option if you want to try any restaurant in Acurio, other than Tanta. We went at 13:30 and waited 30 minutes. But as of 14:00 they were already told 1h or more.

reviews.title: Food and differentiated care. Excellent.
reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant, excellent food, differentiated. The service is very attentive, we expected a lot in the queue, but it was worth waiting.
reviews.review_tip: Não se estressar com a fila e não desistir...vale a pena.

reviews.title: Lima top for lunch with friends or family
reviews.text: Ideal to go in large groups to lunch, order different dishes and taste everything... hearty and delicious food. Chef Gaston present and greeting some of his diners, Mood pleasant and with a musical selection of salsa that only fills with joy and feeling of abundance

reviews.title: Traditional in Lima
reviews.text:
I've been there twice, and it's still a good choice for seafood. Ceviche, seafood rice, and others like chaufa rice with picanha are very good, and the noodles are delicious. The parmesan shells are very dry.
The place is very noisy and the tables are very close together.
Otherwise it is recommended.

reviews.title: The sea was calm and beautiful
reviews.text: The best I've tried in Lima, elegant ceviche, delicious octopus in olive oil, and chicharron de pescado, all at the right temperature, with the right portions, pleasant music, Sammy's service, a very nice atmosphere, very friendly hosts, a luxury. Thank you.
reviews.review_tip: Porciones chifas sin muy generosas, pero lo general y sugiero, compartan y luevo piden el fondo,si pueden, cocktail ricos.

reviews.title: Spectacular flavors!!
reviews.text: We loved the food from this place!!: a very professional and friendly treatment and exquisite flavors. The price for being Lima is somewhat more expensive than elsewhere but it is well worth it. We ordered 2 first, a large grilled fish (I recommend it), a dessert and 4 waters, 110€. For my taste, the best place we ate in Lima!!

reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.text: Delicious ceviches! Restaurant crowded! Everything worked super well! The price is super higher according to the quality of the dishes!!! I recommend!

reviews.title: Disappointment on first visit.
reviews.text:
- The atmosphere is extremely noisy, which generates discomfort (volume of the music excessively loud).
- The tastes clearly well achieved, classic, but at the same time without novelties and without surprises; nothing that in any other cevicheria, less recognized, can not be found.
- Attention; I perceived the rush to present the background dish, when it was still in the middle of the entrance (it should be mentioned that there were a lot of people waiting outside the restaurant), you had to give continuity to the "production line".
First impression, disappointing.

reviews.title: Service and wonderful food
reviews.text:
Wonderful service and the food is not even spoken. Everything we asked for was wonderful. A
Highlight for the chocolate mousse with quinoua and for the vieiras.

reviews.title: 5 stars excellent fish
reviews.text:
"La Mar Cebichería" in Lima, Peru, is undoubtedly a jewel of Peruvian cuisine and a must for seafood lovers. The freshness of the ingredients is unparalleled, and the ceviche is simply divine, with a perfect balance of flavors. The menu offers a variety of creative dishes that enhance the country's culinary tradition, making each visit a unique experience. 

The atmosphere is informal but welcoming, with attentive and friendly service that makes every guest special. La Mar is the ideal place to enjoy authentic food in a lively environment. I highly recommend trying the classic ceviche, accompanied by a fresh pisco sour for a complete dining experience. A real treasure for culinary connoisseurs!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere ... excellent service ... we ate ceviche that was delicious ... a delicious seafood plate ... we sat in the bar, watching the fresh fish next to us on ice ... very good the truth would go again ... ahhh dessert , homemade lucuma ice cream ... A delight 👏👏👏👏

reviews.title: Super pleasant environment
reviews.text: Excellent service! Food and drinks of good quality! We were taken care of by Ivan, who gave full attention and clarifications about dishes and drinks.

reviews.title: Good Chicha morada and ceviche
reviews.text: The food was quite good, I ordered a ceviche with its respective chicha morada and it was perfect. We had to wait a long time, but they always brought us potatoes and sweet potato for the wait which gives them another point. Nice bathrooms, but a bit dirty and the place is quite cozy.

reviews.title: La Mar Cebichería - A unique gastronomic experience
reviews.text: Excellent place , care , decoration and especially the ceviche prepared with great ingredients and fresh fish
reviews.review_tip: Não faz reserva . Chegou cedo mas se tiver que esperar , tome um drink . Vale a pena a espera

reviews.title: Iconic ceviche and cool cocktails
reviews.text:
Excellent place to try a Peruvian food! There is a big menu - you’ll definitely not be disappointed with your choice. Many ceviche options (mixto is cool), different sashimi (tuna toro is excellent), cold and hot appetizers, raws (tiraditos trio is awesome), grill, dishes with rice and other main dishes. Everything is very tasty: fresh fish, big portions, nice serving. 
There are different cocktails: of course, classic ones (pisco sour is the best) and good variety of signature cocktails. There are beers, wines and liquors as well.
There are many seating places. The restaurant is very popular, but they don’t offer reservations, sometimes you have to wait some time. It’s rather convenient - they offer small tables, so you can order some drinks and snacks.

reviews.title: The best dining experience of my life!!
reviews.text:
We arrive at 12 noon because there is usually waiting to get place (they do not take reservations) and we enter without waiting.
First class service, amazing food, spectacular drinks
The best dining experience of my life!!
reviews.review_tip: Llegar temprano para evitar hecer fila

reviews.title: La Mar Experience
reviews.text: Good was really good, we did not like the Causa with crab, it was not good tbh. The rest just amazing! Service was in another lever and their cocktails wow! Highly recommended

reviews.title: Peruvian food reference
reviews.text: Since we went to lime we knew we wanted to go to the sea to eat. Excellent reference to local food , delicious and varied flavors. Portions are large so they can be shared between 2 people. Very good service very friendly waiters and very nice atmosphere. They sell chef's books. The chocolate mousse dessert was the richest!
reviews.review_tip: Compartir platos pues son muy generosos y se pueden probar más cosas

reviews.title: Imperdible - great ceviches and relaxed place
reviews.text: The place is relaxed, mainly by the decoration and music. The ceviches are amazing. I recommend the black shells and the oatmeal, the latter for those who want to taste something different. Drinks also leave nothing to be desired. The care of wily was sensational, everything he recommended, worked in full! But do not arrive very hungry, as there is no reservation of tables and the wait on the weekend was about 1 hour. Still, I recommend and would return.

reviews.title: Hostess gave her number to my husband out of nowhere
reviews.text: The food and atmosphere were great. However I was really disappointed with the behaviour of the hostess girl. When we arrived we were told the waiting time is around 20 mins which was fine as we knew there is no reservation option here. When we sat down at the table the hostess Carolina completely ignored me and in the middle of the service she came over to my husband and handed him a paper with her phone number and email address written down saying that he can call her next time he wants to come, she can reserve a spot for him. At no point she mentioned me. He thanked her politely and handed me the note. I thought it was weird as there is no reservation system and I wondered why she wants to prioritise him? I added her number on my WhatsApp and her photo came up - half naked in a bikini! This made my visit very uncomfortable and I thought it was very unprofessional and I wonder how many guys she hands these notes to on daily basis? I still have the note, in case I want to book a slot! If I ever fancy to be disrespected again? The management needs to be more careful when selecting employees because incidents like this can put off their customers. We visited Peru, Lima in February this year again but did not go to La Mar. Shame because the restaurant has a nice concept.

reviews.title: Very delicious food but unkempt toilets
reviews.text: On weekends you can't make reservations, but it's worth it. You have to get used to the volume in the attractively designed restaurant. Very delicious and well prepared seafood and Peruvian classics, such as Causa, Suspiro Limeño, Cebiches etc. All food prepared in an exemplary way, seasoned and arranged. But: Both men’s and women’s toilets were unkempt and despite addressing the supervisor nothing happened. In comparison, yesterday at the somewhat larger restaurant “Siete Sopas” on the corner of Petit Thouars - José Pardo, a drip-free, fussy floor in the men’s room. Therefore, unfortunately, I have to deduct 2 points in the evaluation

reviews.title: Beautiful Restaurant but first impression not so well
reviews.text: This place was so beautiful and I went because the reviews were rated very highly but since I got there, it was around the time they were closing 5:00pm I ordered scallops, the seafood and rice and the food was not cooked all the way, which resolved in me having some stomach issues. The people were so friendly, but make sure your food is cooked all the way.
reviews.review_tip: If you’re going to visit this restaurant, I would recommend going early

reviews.title: Great satisfaction.
reviews.text: You can eat fresher seafood than in Japan! Camarero is also very kind and friendly! The clean kitchen is full of activity. We enjoyed a great Lima lunch!

reviews.title: Fresh and delicious!!
reviews.text: Got there at 11:30 am and a line quickly formed before it opened at noon. The dishes were fresh and delicious. The included chips and dipping sauces should be an order able dish by itself - SO Yummy!  We had the ceviche Classico and the ceviche mantora based on our waitress’ recommendation and it was SO GOOD. Our main dishes were just as good (the causa is huge). The open air ambiance was refreshing even on a cloudy muggy day.  Would definitely recommend!!

reviews.title: Amazing place with excellent service
reviews.text:
Having come here for the first time, it was an amazing experience. Our waitress Isabel was outstanding.
She was very helpful going through the menu. Amazing service by her and great food from the kitchen. 
Highly recommend this place.

reviews.title: A first class lunch!!!!
reviews.text: First time I went and loved everything...the atmosphere, the first food and not to mention the attention....We were attended by a Miss Melany...super friendly....
reviews.review_tip: Que lo disfruten

reviews.title: Fabulous Experience
reviews.text: This is the most amazing restaurant! Recommended by Peruvian friends in the UK and we absolutely LOVED it. Brilliant food, lively atmosphere and fantastic people working there. Juan Carlos, Melany and Lesley, one of the chefs behind the bar counter, were all incredibly friendly and guided us expertly through the menu!  It was very impressive watching the wonderful Lesley making intricate desserts behind the bar counter! Thank you all for the most wonderful experience.

reviews.title: Good lunch.
reviews.text: I came to see you first thing in the afternoon! The fish's head greeted me with a thud, and I feel agape. The ceviche is beautifully arranged and tension MAX. After a toast with pisco sour, we savored the fish. The staff were very pleasant, and they felt like they had received a fun and warm reception in Lima!

reviews.title: VERY noisy atmosphere, not necessarily pleasant for foreigners
reviews.text: Very good food, however, the volume of the music is too high. If you are going with foreigners, there are several other places much quieter and with good food.
reviews.review_tip: No es un lugar amigable o tranquilo para conversar. No lleven a extranjeros que no están necesariamente acostumbrados a tanto ruido.

reviews.title: As always first rate
reviews.text: Exquisite Peruvian food is its splendor the flavors are exquisite , its fresh ceviches and the pisco sour too good we always come and I will always recommend it advised to order the pasta from le vongole and add hedgehogs is just an orgasm for the palate.

reviews.title: Great Food!
reviews.text: Excellent ceviche. Excellent Pisco Sour. Excellent service in a VERY busy restaurant! We waited 90mins for a table for two (the initial estimate was 40 mins). Reasonably priced for what you get. An enjoyable experience for sure. We skipped desert in favour of the ice cream spot across the street (creme de la creme) on the recommendation from a friend...BOSS ice cream!! Note: La Mar is only open for lunch...Be there before noon to avoid the wait!

reviews.title: I always come back!
reviews.text: The best ceviche there is! I love this restaurant and whenever I go to Lima, I visit it. Everything is delicious and the service is very good. No reservations are made, so go early or be prepared to wait about 20/30 minutes.
reviews.review_tip: Comam ceviche e causa (prato típico delicioso)!

reviews.title: Where is the Beef?
reviews.text: I enjoyed this restaurant. The only thing I did not like was the small portions for the price. Other than that, I enjoyed the clean and open environment!

reviews.title: Don't hesitate, go eat there!
reviews.text:
I want to recognize the attention and good treatment to customers who go to the restaurant alone, I travel a lot and as alone. Unfortunately, you are rarely treated like large account customers and this speaks volumes of careful and personalized attention. 
Delicious and the service was super!  Everything I ate exceeded my expectations and I highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Memorable Peruvian cuisine
reviews.text: I researched and found a number restaurants in Lima that I wanted to try and selected this one.  I was very happy with my choice.  Food was creative and flavorful.  The server patiently explained the many spices and ingredients that were unfamiliar to me.  I was so impressed with the multiple influences of Peruvian cuisine, from indigenous people, Japanese, Chinese and African, my mouth was an explosion of flavors.  The chef/owner Gáston Acurio wrote the definitive book on Peruvian cuisine.  If the English version had a soft cover I would have bought it.
reviews.review_tip: The place is popular.  Go early or late (just before they close between lunch and dinner).  Fine dining at an affordable price.

reviews.title: Absolute quality
reviews.text:
In the Miraflores district you can have lunch at this seafood restaurant.
Excellent quality food, prices not affordable for all budgets (150 € in two for a seafood starter with lobster).

reviews.title: Outstanding fresh and delectable cuisine
reviews.text: Pisco sour cocktail is a great way to start and it’s perfect! The vibe is bustling and happy. The dining space is open and beach club like, very relaxed. Service is quite good and friendly. Food is outstanding! Ceviche has freshly prepared texture and outstanding balance of flavours. Carpaccio has an unusual preparation and also delicious. The layered potato, egg and tuna tartare is unique and recommended. Seafood rice is excellent. Ice cream is literally the best I’ve ever had. Try to reserve but despite our one hour wait without reservations, it was definitely worth it. Great dining experience, hence the endless queue of patrons waiting for their table.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: In general, the well-run restaurants on this platform are not always the best. Well, La Mar met all our expectations and exceeded them. The previous wait is completely worth it to enjoy this restaurant. It is not cheap, but is 25% more expensive than other locals on average, but worth every peso. All dishes well made and very good tasting. Spectacular tiger milk, ceviches too, pisco sour befitting. The very good service and the party atmosphere inside make it an entertaining experience. Anyway, I would definitely go back to this restaurant on a next visit to Lima.

reviews.title: The Sea a thousand times
reviews.text:
I've had the opportunity to travel and sit at the best tables, but as the
Sea, there is not, perhaps it is something sentimental or simply affinity, its concept, its raw material, its people and those flavors that always fill you.
I'd come back a thousand times

reviews.title: Great place when you get seated...
reviews.text:
This is a walk in restaurant and they don't take reservations. The first time we went we arrived just before 1 p.m. on a Friday. The place was packed and we and had to wait about 30-40 minutes at the bar before getting a table. The food, drinks and service was amazing. We were so happy we went back when we got back to Lima after our tour around Peru. This time we arrived at about 1:45 p.m and waited over 2 hours for a table with no room to wait inside the restaurant. Food and drinks were still good, but we were miserable after the long wait.

You should definitely go to this restaurant, but if you can't get there before 1 p.m. just don't bother going at all. This place is packed, mainly with locals who never seem to leave. Pick out somewhere else and don't waste your afternoon waiting for a table here. It is good, but it's not worth that.
reviews.review_tip: Get there early or just steer clear of the place.

reviews.title: Synonymous with good eating
reviews.text:
It is among the best restaurants in Lima for its gastronomic level.
You always have to go with reservation to enjoy its exquisite flavors.,

reviews.title: Very good as ever
reviews.text:
Despite the queue you have to wait, it is worth it because you know that dishes will not disappoint. The ceviche, the octopus, all very good. But if there's one unmissable, it's the devilfish. The uglier, the richer. I ask whenever I can.
Go early that from 1:30 the wait is already a little long. If you could book it, or avoid that queue, you would give it all 5 stars.

reviews.title: We had our meal at the bar, with a number of fish watching us.  Really nice food.  Chilled atmosphere.
reviews.text:
No booking, you turn up and queue.  Slot available at the bar, would have been 1 hour wait for a table at 13:00 on a Friday.

We had our meal at the bar, with a number of fish watching us.  Really nice food.  Chilled atmosphere.

reviews.title: Delicious ceviche in a nice setting .open for lunch only !
reviews.text:
Great and friendly service service ! One can not reserve a table ! 
We got there just after opening at 12.02 on a Friday . No line at that point but at 1 pm there was a lot of people waiting for a table . They gave us some chips and three different dipping sauces  and a corn snack to start with . They have lots of cocktails to choose from . I just had a zero Corona . 
I had a ceviche taco as a starter , 2 small and delicious tacos and then a white fish ceviche as a main course  , Medium  hot . I was completely full  . . My husband had picarones as a dessert - a sweet potato donut with a kind of warm honey for dipping . Really nice lunch and so think a lot of other people as well . They have many tables but I recommend you to be there at opening for lunch

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Excellent wonderful food, very good service? The person who attended me, did wonderfully the very good recommendations

reviews.title: Delights of the sea in every spoonful!
reviews.text: The reviews I've read about this restaurant don't do it justice.  My wife and I are seafood lovers and definitely, we ate some Top-rated seafood dishes we've ever tasted.  The treatment of the waiters, the information and recommendations provided, the organization and cleanliness of the place during our visit, and the delicious drinks, made our afternoon an unforgettable one.
reviews.review_tip: El mejor consejo es llegar temprano, porque asisten muchos clientes.

reviews.title: Ceviche and rich fish!
reviews.text: Very peculiar place, very cool! Super friendly waiters! Welcome chips with sauces, very delicious! The best... the ‘poke’ with rice and different raw fish and seafood with a spiced mayonnaise, AMAZING. Delicacy dessert, very delicious! Great to start our trip through Peru.

reviews.title: Marine experience
reviews.text:
The best ceviche and oysters in Lima.
Fresh oysters, fresh fishing and sea chorizo a delight.
Balanced and beautiful sour.
The slightly traditional jelly compared to the different and peculiar snacks and entrees.
Friendly atmosphere and Flower our very friendly and nearby area.

reviews.title: Best in Lima?
reviews.text: Must be Lima's best ceviche. It was very good. We also ate ravioli and pasta gratin with prawns. All absolutely fantastic. Nice environment and fantastic service.

reviews.title: Great restaurant
reviews.text: A very large selection of dishes, everything proved delicious. The portions are huge) Service at the highest level, friendly staff, delicious compliments on the table. Hostes originally said the table was waiting 40 minutes, but we were locked up after 20. I recommend it!

reviews.title: WOW! WOW! WOW!
reviews.text: Absolutely sensational in every respect.  Just go.  We were with friends who were local, so that helped with the language.  We went on a Monday shortly after noon and there was no line.  The meal, the service, the drinks,...everything was like the best dream ever.

reviews.title: Unmissable for visitors to Lima
reviews.text: Relaxed and cheerful environment offering excellent Peruvian food! Visitors to Lima who would like to taste the seafood cuisine of Peru can not fail to visit this restaurant.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: We loved this restaurant. Seafood is fresh and flavorful. We tried the crab in sauce, and the grilled seafood platter. Both were great. We even returned another day. I recommend to get there when they open at 12pm to avoid long waiting time. It gets busy

reviews.title: Cuddle between flights
reviews.text:
Great cebiche, Daniel the guy who followed us and 'was great at advising and also indicating what I could eat gluten free being celiac... excellent pisco sour!
Highly recommended! We moved the flight to Arequipa only to come and have lunch here after the flight from Italy! Exceptional

reviews.title: 5 stars ceviche!
reviews.text:
Amazing food and cocktails! Nice vibes and music as well.
We were looking for the best ceviche in town and we were satisfied!

reviews.title: Earthbound Adventures tour
reviews.text: Been here few years ago and decided to visit absolutely did not disappoint and only get better you'll have to have a reservation if you want to have a lunch but if you don't mind sitting in the bar it's a little bit easier to fight. It's open only for lunch so there is high demand for this place. Order the whole fish,  Chita a la parilla, You come covered with chimichurri with capers They face is amazing every bite exploding your mouth It's flaky it's fresh and it's really amazing dish for dessert I have the chocolate mousse over lukuma mousse, it served in the Coco pod and have roasted quinoa on top amazing combination beautifully presented and really good.

reviews.title: Lunch
reviews.text:
We went without Reservation and were treated without problems, but the ideal is to make a Reservation due to the movement. The food is tasty and made with quality ingredients; it is worth following the suggestions of the house. The service is very good. And don't forget to try the desserts, it's worth every calorie.

Super recommend

reviews.title: Love their dishes.
reviews.text:
After 5 days hiking at Cusco, all foods is so good. Among them, I missed La Mar Cheviche plates.  Love Sashimi but now on Cheviche. Tried all their cheviche. Went early and wait out side bench. It worth. 
Spent $546.00

reviews.title: Stay away over priced and way over hyped
reviews.text: Extremely over priced, two glasses of house Chardonnay, 12 oysters, one soup came out to 200 US DOLLARS that’s ridiculous! We live in Miami and only come close to that when out at Michelin star top tier restaurants. Way over priced to eat at what looks like a back yard with a tarp over it and bamboo sticks. Service was amazing which was the only positive take away. Stay far away from this money vacuum. Their food was comparable to riconcito Latinos found in Miami. So so so disappointing, other spots in Peru blow this place out of the water and are far far far cheaper. PANCHITA owned by the same chef as le mar is far better and cheaper and much nicer ambiance. The most disappointing experience in our time at Peru. What a let down.
reviews.review_tip: Interior needs revamp, cleanliness and professionalism are highlights, food and atmosphere are offensive

reviews.title: A top Lima restaurant
reviews.text:
We found this place when searching through the best restaurants in Lima. We visited after a few days of travel in Peru. And we are so glad that we went. 

The food was great - the seafood was fresh and delicious. We had Mixto Ceviche, Empanadas, Conchitas a la parmasena and Arron con Mariscos among the four of us and that was plentiful. The cocktails were nice, if only had more ice than alcohol :) The ambience and music was great as was the service. The price was reasonable for the quality of the food (one would easily pay 2x in US)

It should be on the must-go list for any foodie visiting Lima.

reviews.title: Best ceviche
reviews.text: A huge selection of ceviche, best we have had! Was so delicious, if you are looking for one place to have ceviche in Lima, this is it.

reviews.title: La Mar!
reviews.text: It's the richest cebiche we've ever eaten! Excellent service despite the crowded local. I recommend the cebiche chalaco and the traditional dessert sigh...you will not regret it!

reviews.title: Wonderful Lunch
reviews.text: Simply a great visit by a solo traveler — decor, vibe, service and above all, excellent food. The flavors were wonderful as was the Pisco.

reviews.title: Unmissable
reviews.text: Extraordinary option to try Peruvian cuisine. Your ceviche is unmissable, anyone you order is amazing. Service if you leave some to be desired. I think it closes very early.

reviews.title: Wonderful La Mar
reviews.text:
Back in 2015 I was lucky to visit the newly opened La Mar in Buenos Aires and was blown away with the flavours.   This was my first experience of not just cevice but Peruvian food.  We returned for our last night and this time met the chef and owner Anthony Vasquez who generously spend time with many diners.   
I have a shot time in Peru and learnt that La Mar was only a few miles from my accommodation so it was a must. My experience was even better. Willie looked after me and gave me some great recommendations.   On learning I loved scallops, he gave me 2 smaller servings of 2 very different scallop starters; the first served in lightly spiced oil and the second with parmesan foam; both delicious. I asked for bread to make sure none of the oils went to waste.   
My main was the prawns with fettuccine and a rich sauce.  The portion was way too much so tonight's dinner will be a real treat.  
I did try the home made ice cream. I didn't quite catch the name but is made from avocado which was another recommendation from Willie. I wasn't sure what to expect but a smooth and firm texture was very paletable.  The taste was very similar to butterscotch so was a delight.  
To drink I had the sunset cocktail made with Singleton, lime and bitters; perfect for this Scottish whisky lover.  I also tried the Pisco Sour and will definitely be having more of this.  
The food was outstanding and service attentive and efficient. Willie is an asset to la Mar as I would probably never have chosen the gems he offered.   The highlight, was meeting Anthony again after 7.5 years.  What a lovely and talented man.   Please open a la Mar in the UK.
reviews.review_tip: Speak to the service team and allow them to offer recommendations.

reviews.title: Delicious and fresh!
reviews.text: La Mar has the freshest, tastiest seafood I’ve ever had!  The leche de Tigre ceviche was so fresh it melted in my mouth.  And the ambience was so festive, even on a Monday afternoon.

reviews.title: Great food! Good wine selection. They don't take reservations. Get there early.
reviews.text:
Food was great! service excellent. Fair wine selectionWe shared a White fish ceviche. My husband had ravioli filled with crab in octopus sauce.
I ate lenguado. It was pretty good.
reviews.review_tip: Ceviche and Lenguado

reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text:
I hadn't gone in years because they had told me that the level had dropped a lot, but I was pleasantly surprised that all the dishes were very good.
Would go again.

reviews.title: Best ceviche in Lima
reviews.text: This is the ultimate spot to see and be seen eating the freshest seafood in Lima. We had the trio of ceviches, the tiradato tasting, and grilled pulpo. This is the gold standard for ceviche.

reviews.title: GREAT SEAFOOD
reviews.text:
Enjoyed lunch there. Some of the best prepared seafood we ever tasted. This coming from people who grew up alongside the Atlantic Ocean (Nova Scotia).
A tip - you cannot make a reservation at this restaurant. We arrived 15 minutes before opening and there was already a line forming. When we left the restaurant 2 hours later, an even longer line had formed.
We were not really in tune with Peruvian food. Sergio, our server, was very helpful with respect to guiding us through the menu.
The only negative, the music was very loud, making it difficult to hear, even at a small table of four.
reviews.review_tip: get to the restaurant early and be prepared to wait for a table. It's worth the wait.

reviews.title: Must try in Lima!
reviews.text: Best seafood meal we had in Lima. We went late at 2pm and had to wait 1.5 hours for a table. The restaurant is so popular people kept coming in and there is always a queue for it. The hostess is so good at her job as she remembers our names and knows where we sat so we wouldn't miss our table when it was our turn. She is so friendly even though everyone kept bugging her for a table! We ordered one ceviche which the waiter recommended. To be honest the ceviche we had was alright as it tasted like any other ceviche we had elsewhere but the other grilled dishes and black ravioli was exceptional. Highly recommend and we hope we have a chance to return when we depart from Lima.

reviews.title: Best ceviche in Lima!
reviews.text: The ceviche in this place is the best I have ever had in my life! Definately must try in Lima. The only slight problem is that you can’t book in advance so there is a waiting list. We overcame the problem by popping up, leaving our name and then having a quick beer next door for a while. The food was so good that we didn’t mind waiting for a bit.

reviews.title: Incredible Food and Fun Atmosphere
reviews.text: The wait to get into this restaurant was worth it! The food was incredible. I like the ceviche the best. Super cute atmosphere, great vibe and staff was so friendly and helpful. I would absolutely recommend this restaurant and hope to come back one day.

reviews.title: AWFUL
reviews.text: I went with my dad to lunch, according to several comments we saw that it was good and that, even more so because it was from Gastón, we wanted to go, the service was good but not that we should say 10/10, they do take a long time and sometimes I think they forget your order, the prices seemed very expensive for their quality of food and flavor, we ordered a ceviche and I think the fish was not up to date, then we added a seafood chaufa and it was malaso from the rice to everything and it was only one portion and still So the bill came out expensive.

reviews.title: Prices according to good taste
reviews.text: The location is very good, but unfortunately the waiting time is very long (they should improve the waiting area), since only a few are offered to enter the bar while they wait, this must be for everyone. Overall, the service is good, but they should be much more attentive to the cleanliness of the toilets (at least the ladies' one was unpleasant), being a large place I don't understand why it doesn't have a second floor... The food is not bad for the prices as well as the drinks, you can see a bit of favoritism in the queue (somewhat disappointing because it is obvious, but I hope it can improve)

reviews.title: AWFUL
reviews.text:
Today the staff admitted hundreds of diners, having registered our visit in advance. We couldn't eat after 2 hours of waiting and having drunk alcoholic beverages. Same ones that were paid in the absence of personnel.
It is a shame that foreign people have this terrible experience in such a beautiful country.
We had to leave the place when we noticed that there was no longer anyone waiting. THEY IGNORED US IN THEIR WAITING ROOM.
TERRIBLE SERVICE
reviews.review_tip: No acudir

reviews.title: Sophisticated
reviews.text: Sophisticated, pleasant and well-organized place. I arrived without a reservation but was promptly served by the great waiters.

reviews.title: Family lunch
reviews.text: I went to visit Lima with my family, after a few years and they maintain their excellent quality and service, I will definitely return every time I go to Lima,
reviews.review_tip: el personal es mmuy minucioso en su atencion, estar tranquilo que siempre hay unna opción para todo tipo de paladar

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Very bad service, not very tasty food, ceviche and leche de tigre don't taste good, we also ordered it with little spice, they brought everything very spicy and they didn't want to change the dishes until we had to talk to other staff. Appalling!

reviews.title: The ceviche is very acidic and difficult to eat.
reviews.text: The ceviche was very acidic and not very tasty, I expected more from this restaurant, I was disappointed, the other dishes were ok, but none of them were very tasty, I would not go again

reviews.title: Unmissable in Lima
reviews.text: Bueno La Mar is a must in Lima, exquisite food, impeccable service!! Top of top!! I just love it!! And a few years ago when I went to a meeting of several chefs and Astrid and Gastón were there, in the bathroom I met Astrid who was a sweetheart and came to greet my family at my table and then took me to her table to greet all!! We shared a moment and they were so nice and easy that my whole family came up to take photos!! The most!!
reviews.review_tip: Prueben todo lo que puedan todo es deliciosoooo!!

reviews.title: Sooo good
reviews.text: As always, La Mar was exceptional. We had the Tiradito and the causa. Our friends think that we are crazy when we tell them that we went to Lima just for the food…It is worth it. Warning do not have more than one Pisco, sour for lunch or your afternoon shot.

reviews.title: Who would have thought they would try a fish and seafood choripán 🤣🙌🏻
reviews.text:
We went to spend Father's Day in Lamar, and it was a very good recommendation.

The restaurant is spacious and has a bar and several tables, the service was sincere, fast and friendly (since without a reservation it can take a while to get a table).

We were surprised by the menu, varied with innovative dishes which I will mention later. The portions are not enough to fill the stomach (according to my brother who eats x2 🤣), we were planning to share everything so we tried a little bit of everything.

We ask:
- Sea choripán (conger eel and prawns)
- Empanadas (shrimp and crab)
- Oriental ceviche (trout and fried noodles)
- Traditional ceviche
- Breaded

All colorful, unique dishes, mixing well-known concepts with different ingredients!

Who would have thought they would try a fish and seafood choripán 🤣🙌🏻

reviews.title: If you’re in Peru you MUST visit this restaurant. The food, the service, everything was a hit.
reviews.text: This restaurant is easily a 10/10. We had amazing service thanks to Mr Willy Castillo! He was so attentive and recommended some amazing dishes. My husband has also been on the search for black whiskey and when we found it here Willy went out of his way to make the experience so special by sharing more info on the whiskey and recommending local places to purchase. On top of amazing service the food was AWESOME! Everything was so fresh and out of the 6 dishes we tried not one was a miss. We found this gem on our last day in Lima and wish we could come back! Will definitely recommend to everyone we know who will visit Peru!

reviews.title: LA MAR SHOULD BE IN YOUR ITINERARY
reviews.text: This place is very popular with locals and tourists, but it's worth the wait because the food is excellent, the atmosphere is open, there is no air conditioning, and it is a little hot. The price is fair for the quality of the service and food.

reviews.title: Peruvian seafood A1
reviews.text:
Great seafood!!!
The price is a bit expensive but the portions are generous. Everything is super fresh and that is important, especially when it comes to fish and seafood. Bustling place, full of life and aromas that whet your appetite. Good attention. Super recommended.

reviews.title: Fantastico - Fantastic
reviews.text:
Fantástica comida - prueba cualquier cebiche y el lenguado. excelente servicio - meseros amables, serviciales, y como en pocos lugares: le saben y les da gusto contestar preguntas y hacer recomendaciones. pidan por Henry. 

fantastic food - try the ceviche sampler and the "lenguado" fish. excellent service - friendly waiters, attentive, and unlike other places: the stuff knows their stuff and are super happy to answer questions and make recommendations. we were attended by Henry, great guy.

reviews.title: Good restaurant
reviews.text: Good restaurant, delicious food, however, you have to wait approximately an hour to enter, you cannot make a reservation

reviews.title: Very good restaurant. He lives up to his fame
reviews.text: We went for lunch, it is located in the Miraflores sector, easy to get to. Good service, wait no more than 10 minutes while they assign us a table since we attended without a reservation. Delicious dishes, quite large portions. It is definitely a very good option to eat very well.

reviews.title: Despite waiting a long time for a table, it was worth it to savor the exquisite dishes they serve.
reviews.text:
The food was spectacularly prepared and served, with an exquisite flavor and freshness of the fish.
Cebiches, causa, grilled octopus, I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: It's not a good restaurant
reviews.text: The food is not very good, the cocktails are tasteless, for what we ended up paying… it leaves a lot to be desired, I do not recommend it

reviews.title: Treat singles horribly.
reviews.text: I try restaurants before bring larger groups.  This spot does not like solo travelers or single persons at their restaurant. They will not seat you anywhere even at the bar. Worst disrespect I have had in my entire 3 weeks in Peru. One hour, ignored while many others were seated they came in after me. All the while there was a seat at the bar available. They lost out on my sampling all the ceviche and a bottle of wine. Do not go to La Mar. There are better places.

reviews.title: Good ceviche
reviews.text: I went to this restaurant to try the ceviche. Good food, modern and clean place, price a little above the city average. Advised.

reviews.title: Ideal summer stop
reviews.text: Very comfortable terrace and indoor option in case of high heat, with a cool atmosphere ideal for summer, friendly service, they know the menu and little waiting time. Very good cuisine, extensive menu. top flavor and presentation. High price but it doesn't hurt to pay! Comfortable environment ideal for F&F. You can't miss the Lima causes

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: The truth is that I had a not very pleasant experience in this restaurant, I went with my partner to try the food at La Mar because I received very good recommendations. The restaurant hostess Carolina was very rude and rude, this didn't surprise as other customers were really complaining, they should check the attention of their staff and improve the waiting facilities. Wait 2 hours on a newspaper. The food was delicious but the portion was small and overpriced for the attention they provide. I don't recommend it and I wouldn't go back...

reviews.title: Terrible attention! A shame in the past, the best restaurant in South America!
reviews.text: A total shame!! I came today with some foreign friends to let them try it since this restaurant seems to me to be the best in Peruvian food, even though the food is still delicious, I was totally disappointed with the super bad attention from the entrance with the girl who was totally unfriendly, she thought she was The owner of the totally obsolete place, the waiters were very rude and did not solve our problems. The quality of the dishes is the same but because of the attention I will not return again!

reviews.title: Terrible attention at the entrance from the “host” bad experience wanting to celebrate a birthday
reviews.text: What a shame… the experience we had was terrible, starting from the entrance with a girl who is called “hostess” and has nothing to do with hostesses. His treatment of the girl is called Carolina if I'm not mistaken, terrible, she lacks tact in speaking, in dealing... a person like that should not be the face at the entrance of a restaurant at sea level. She was disrespectful with the treatment a little more and took the plates off the table putting her arms in our faces when we asked her to change tables because the sun was very strong after waiting more than an hour to be able to have a table… terrible treatment and it continued With her bad attitudes it seemed like she was doing us a favor. The food was good, nothing out of this world, the portions of all the mixed ceviche were very, very small. However, they realized it because we told them and they changed the porfion for an adequate portion for the price... the other dishes were ok, nothing out of this world for the price... we spent more than 540 Soles than really with the treatment from the entrance and above It was the birthday of one of us, they gave us complimentary dessert but the bad experience was already there... what a shame, being one of my favorite places I can't recommend going... they should do something urgent with the hostess and put someone who really is friendly and knows how to deal with tact and respect.

reviews.title: Good food but HORRIBLE SERVICE.
reviews.text: This restaurant stands out for the high quality of its dishes, however despite being listed as one of the best restaurants in the world... the service is highly deficient and with 0 tact. From the entrance we were surprised by the disinterest and bad attitude of the host lady, the rowdy and disorganized waiters. The attitude of the staff totally disinterested and pedantic. We went to celebrate a birthday and despite the good taste of all their dishes, they completely ruined our outing. We have never received such bad service at this restaurant before. They tried to make up for their mistreatment by giving two desserts, but the damage was already done. Of all their staff there was only 1 who cared about fixing our experience…

reviews.title: Bad experience - Terrible service.
reviews.text: We went to the sea today to celebrate my mother's birthday, to which the host Carolina received us, with a very contemptuous attitude and with the manner as if she were doing us a favor, she had unfriendly treatment towards us, we hope About 1 hour before our table, they put us at a table next to the sun in a very uncomfortable place to which the host Carolina was indifferent, treating us badly and looking at us with a bad face. The food is very good, which is why we came as we usually do, but it must be said that we were surprised by the terrible attention of the staff, they made us feel very uncomfortable and neglected, as they were apologetic, they gave us a dessert, which did not solve the disdain already caused. Which completely ruined our day and our terrible mom's birthday.

reviews.title: The best sea food
reviews.text:
The best seafood restaurant I ever went to incredible 
The sea unchins were incredible huge and delicious

reviews.title: Best ceviche in the world
reviews.text: Where everything was born. Acurio's famous cebicheria that is a 10 in everything. As in all of Peru, the attention is superior and the waiters are attentive to your every movement. The ceviche was very spicy and exquisite and the breaded rolls were delirious. Unforgetable experience.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text:
Very nice place, with excellent service.
The waiter gave us good advice and it was a pleasant meal.
Quite reasonable price.
It is advisable to go early (before 1 p.m.) to avoid having to wait, since they work without reservation.

reviews.title: Very good food and service
reviews.text:
The two of us arrived at around 12:30pm on a Sunday. We got a table right away.

The ambience was much more casual than some other famous restaurants I visited in Lima. The staff members were nonetheless very friendly and helpful.

The menu was very extensive. A lot of things were on offer. The two of us shared one ceviche, one tiradito and a black ravioli stuffed with crab meat. All dishes were good. The ravioli was the best. The crab meat filling was alright, but the chupe sauce was very tasty. The complimentary corn snack was also very good. it was much better than the ones we found in the supermarkets.

We spent around US$30 per person. It was not cheap for Peruvian standard. But there's no way I can find food of this quality and taste back at home.

reviews.title: Excellent atention
reviews.text: Great experience. Black ravioli stuffed with prawns. Wonderful. Excellent silverside tiradito

reviews.title: The best Peruvian restaurant!!
reviews.text:
We come from Europe and the first thing we wanted to try was this restaurant since it has been highly recommended to us.
Exquisite food that each dish is really special and of good quality. We had to return 2 days later since it was very good and the service was the best. We were attended by Miss Isabela who recommended typical Peruvian dishes.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: The mixed ceviche is exquisite, the grilled octopus has a native flavor with anticuchera sauce, pulled silverside

reviews.title: It's not worth the reputation it has. I won't be back and I don't recommend it!
reviews.text: The first question is: are you interested in good food or posting on social media? I was interested in the first one and it was a disappointment. Looking at the comments from other customers, it seems like we went to different restaurants. I've been to this restaurant 3 times. Two in Bogotá where I only ate ceviche (which wasn't that good, very acidic and with 40% volume of onion) and yesterday in Lima which was a total disappointment. We ordered a combination of 3 ceviches to try and none of the 3 impressed, in fact the traditional one impressed negatively due to the exaggerated acidity and the small quantity served. We then ordered a main course which was a total ruin, with a combination of sauces that in a rough comparison was like serving a very thin steak with spicy tomato sauce on one side of the plate and mustard on the other (these 2 sauces don't even match the stick). It was a fish fillet about 1.5 cm thick (as if it were a thin fish tail) with prawns and a spicy red sauce and on the other half of the plate there was a greenish sauce that in no way matched the first. I left the restaurant nauseated. I can't understand how a famous chef would come up with such a crazy combination. A total frustration. Furthermore, it is very expensive, because if it were good it would already be expensive but justifiable, but if it was bad it becomes very expensive. I don't recommend it nor will I return. This dish is disgusting and the ceviche of more than 15 restaurants in Peru (including roadside self-service for tourists) by the famous chef Gaston was the weakest. Furthermore, the combo of 3 small portions of ceviche cost 130 soles. In other restaurants you would eat much better for half the price or even less. It's worth mentioning that we were also at chicha, the famous chef's restaurant in Cuzco, and the starter (an alpaca fillet) was very good but the second course was also disappointing. It was a mixture of chicken, pork (both tasteless) and lamb (the only one that was saved) in a strong sauce immersed in a sea of potatoes. Another disappointment. We ate in wonderful restaurants in Cuzco (chef elmer (I forgot the name of the restaurant), pisoc (rest la ruta), ollantaytambo (restaurant verônica), all unforgettable and that gave the famous chef a run for his money. In lima the best restaurant for ceviche is called Se punto azul, in Miraflores. Simply sensational mixed ceviche, well served and at a fair price, so much so that it's crowded all the time. Now if your goal is to post your photos, go to the famous one that gets the most likes.

reviews.title: 2 lunches in a row
reviews.text: We went one day, we liked it so much that we came back the next! Starting with the cover charge, which is complimentary. I could just stay at the cover and drink the great drinks the house offers! We tried a little bit of everything: ceviche, octopus, squid, scallop, sea urchin, etc. It's so worth it! You won't regret it.

reviews.title: EXQUISITE
reviews.text: We arrived without a reservation since we just landed in Lima that day, we did not have to wait for a table, the service and friendliness of the staff is very outstanding. The food is exquisite, the ceviche octopus, perfectly cooked, beautiful presentation, the restaurant is very pleasant.... I will return without thinking about it when I return to Lima.

reviews.title: Overpriced, poor service, food cold. Avoid.
reviews.text:
This place may have once been great, but our experience today suggests they have become slack, with very poor service and cold food. Overpriced for what you receive.
On arrival at 145 pm on a Friday there is a wait list for 1.5hrs. Peak hour, fair enough! We did not book. Thats ok for us. We went to get a coffee then came back and waited till 2hrs, so another 30 mins.
Very hard to catch wait staff to take our order, 15 mins. Wanted an authentic peruvian coastal seafood experience; very little help from waitstaff despite my partner being fluent in Spanish. Their advice was very brief and not useful from  two different wait staff. They were not engaged/didn't seem interested in giving us even brief advise on what may be good to try as their "signature dishes." Our entrees arrived very cold, supposed to both be hot grilled food. The vegetables not fresh, potatoes floury. 
We advised wait staff we were not happy with the cold food, given the wait time, the high price and that this is a premier dining venue.
We will not be returning.
Overpriced, seemingly taking advantage of tourists, relying on what may have once been a premier dining experience. There is a new place nearby that we checked out on our way home. Same road. May be worthwhile.

reviews.title: The Sea Lima
reviews.text:
Delicious food and extensive menu, with reasonable prices according to the quality of their products.
Very short opening hours.

reviews.title: I would return several times
reviews.text:
Wonderful tuna ceviche with a smoked touch
The belle menière fish was divine with butter caper sauce and a touch of lemon
Black crab ravioli very good too

reviews.title: Wonderful.
reviews.text: I recommend this place to all lovers of good food. The restaurant serves delicious dishes with fresh products and impeccable seasoning. The service is also excellent. We went on a Sunday and, therefore, the waiting line was very long, but that was not a problem, as the restaurant offers a space for you to sit and drink that delicious pisco. I want to go back.

reviews.title: The wait was worth it
reviews.text: The wait was long, but it was worth it, from the service at the entrance with the native chips, the chilies, not to mention the ceviche, jelly, cause. Between the cost and quantity it was fair and necessary. I would sincerely recommend it again .

reviews.title: Best ceviche everywhere
reviews.text: We came to Lima looking for this restaurant. We have been at their franchises in San Francisco and Panama. Outstanding freshness and great service. Order the flight of ceviches to try a bit of each one. Anything grilled is so tasty as well. We had Chilcano drinks! The Chilcano maracuyá is the best.

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: Everything was great and exceptional treatment. Always attentive and kind, the food is impressive, highly recommended

reviews.title: The best cevicheria in Peru
reviews.text: Even though we arrived late, they served us super quickly, with super service and very delicious dishes, A1 attention and the best drinks.

reviews.title: Perfect drinks, delicious food
reviews.text: Excellent food, highly recommended, the best aphrodisiac ceviche, we return in all ways.

reviews.title: One of the best seafood restaurants
reviews.text:
WOW.   I had such a great time at La Mar, a seafood restaurant that had everything I would dream of in a seafood restaurant.

Tones of seafood on display, they couldn’t be fresher if I caught them myself.  Open happy space. Laid back vibe.  No wonder La Mar is one of the world’s 50 best restaurants 

The food was amazing, I totally loved the ceviche.  The sea urchin was beyond amazing.  Look at the size of it.  I have never seen anything like that.  

I met with the chef 👨‍🍳. I got some amazing appetizers.  The service was beyond implacable. 

I totally loved this restaurant. 💖

reviews.title: How wonderful
reviews.text:
We couldn't order everything we wanted, we need to go back.
The dishes are delicious, the house has three kitchens that simultaneously prepare the most beautiful and delicious dishes!!!
Top marks in everything.

reviews.title: Seafood Extravaganza!
reviews.text:
This is the place to come for a sumptuous, delectable, and fresh seafood extravaganza! The quantity and quality of fresh fish here is
amazing! Service was very attentive and courteous, but not intrusive. A party of 10 sampled almost everything on the menu, and the sea urchin, ceviche, and trucha were excellent! It was served on huge boats and everything tasted freshly caught. Atmosphere is festive, fun, and upscale. We came for lunch. Be sure to make reservations at this place as it is quite busy.

reviews.title: One of my favorite lunch venues
reviews.text:
Great seafood options, eclectic and interesting menu, good service, comfortable setting.  Their specialities are cebiche and tiradito but they have many other dishes and every one is excellent.  I’ve been here maybe a dozen times and have sampled many dishes. 

It does get busy and they do not accept reservations.

reviews.title: Essential
reviews.text: Fantastic place to eat ceviche and tiraditos. I have loved everything I have tried. Excellent price/quality ratio. Essential

reviews.title: The Best Ceviche in the World
reviews.text: Those who know, know. Those who don’t, don’t. If you are looking for the best ceviche restaurant in Latin America, then you’ve come to the right place. La Mar came recommended by numerous friends around the world who enjoy fresh seafood. When we told them about our planned trip to Peru in the coming months, they had two words, La Mar. We didn’t make reservations, so we had to sit at the bar, which turned out to be an extraordinary experience. We ended up sitting next to a friendly guy named Rey, who it just so happened, to be the primary distributor of fish to the restaurant. He helped us select the best ceviche on the menu, specifically the ceviche trio, which allowed us to sample different types of ceviche, that we would otherwise not have access to. We highly recommend La Mar if you want a great spot for some delicious and authentic ceviche.

reviews.title: Cevicheria not to be missed if you travel to Miraflores, Lima
reviews.text: Very good experience. Delicious food, prompt and very friendly service. Special mention for Willy, the boy who served us, who gave us very good recommendations from the menu. Highly recommended, when we visit Lima again we will surely return.

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Very good service, good seasoning, local A1 I recommend them for all types of gatherings with family, friends or work groups, they have a very extensive menu

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: Incredible ceviche! We tried the tasting Ceviche menu and it did not disappoint. Our waitress was wonderful and helped us secure a taxi home too.

reviews.title: Amazing ceviche
reviews.text: This is an incredible ceviche restaurant in Lima.  You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. It's a bit of a treat, but not too expensive. Get there around the time it opens to avoid the wait.

reviews.title: great for truly fresh seafood!
reviews.text: amazing seafood; whole fresh fish huge and beautifully prepared! highly recommended - long wait worth it; sashimi great too and you know fresh because a few items sold out; hard to figure out evening closing hours from their website - but definitely open for lunch to early dinner

reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text:
My first trip to Peru was over 20 years ago. I went to the originally astrid and Gaston and loved it. Since then I have tried many of chef Gaston’s other concepts. His restaurants are amazing, I even applied for a job in my teens. 

La mar has always been one of my favourites a must visit in every trip. I have a number of his books and my 6 year old and I regularly cook his dishes. On this trip to Peru it was very special we managed to meet the man him self. You made my daughter and my day. She loved the restaurant and meeting you. A big thank you to you and pepe

You have done so much for Peruvian cooking here and abroad! You have mentored so many chefs and together out Peru food on the map

reviews.title: went twice and would come back more if I was still there
reviews.text: amazing fresh seafood and fish and of course the ceviche's amazing fresh and the service was better, very clean restaurant and the wine list, WoW

reviews.title: Ceviche was amazing
reviews.text: First came to this restaurant back in 2017 and honestly it has not changed a bit. The food is still delicious and we plan on going back on our last day. Willy was our server and was very friendly and awesome.

reviews.title: Friday action packed "late lunch"
reviews.text:
We arrived at 2pm for the famous seafood experience.  We were quoted a one hour wait time, but were seated within 45 mins for a party of three.  

The ambience is amazing, with all covered outside seating in a rustic environment.  It was a chilly spring day, but heaters were available to all.

We ordered one of everything seafood on the menu.  The grilled octopus served similar to a fajita was the highlight.  Ceviches were great, as well as the crab causa.

Has $$$$ rating for a reason, but this is excellent Peruvian food.  A must visit.

And check out the pix.....look who I met and shook hands with during my Sep 23 visit.

reviews.title: Authentic and wonderful Peruvian famous restaurant in Lima which is an institution
reviews.text:
No fuss - excellent Peruvian food.

We visited this restaurant during our trip ( first ever) to Peru. We were curious and wanted to visit this restaurant because we have visited their restaurant in San Francisco and had wonderful experience.

La Mar in Lima is almost like an institution and a must visit simply for their superb food.
This place is so huge, probably accommodates 300 heads and looks like a huge open restaurant. We arrived without reservation because we were told they don’t accept reservations- and I know now why.
When we arrived we were offered seats at the bar but if wanted a table then waiting time of 30 minutes. They have waiting area also.
Luckily we were offered a table within 10-15 minutes. 
We ordered classic ceviche . We noticed that ceviche is spelled differently in different places 😊. We were surprised to see in the menu ‘tigers milk’ as one of the ingredients of ceviche. So checked with them and learnt that it’s the sauce which is called that…
The ceviche was really class ! But the dish that we found absolutely outstanding was the grilled scallops and prawn ( planchette de con) and we also ordered another fish dish- milanessa pobra .
We tried chilcano de pisca which is pisco sour but without eggs.
We are even planning to go back to this restaurant before we fly back home and that tells you how good the food is in this famous Cebicheria.
Service in this overly crowded restaurant is unbelievably superb and very attentive. I really wonder how they deliver such fantastic service in this crowded restaurant.

reviews.title: Great food
reviews.text: Great food and good location in an area with many other restaurants and coffee shops.  Couldn’t get a reservation but were able to get a table without waiting.

reviews.title: Great food every single time!
reviews.text:
As always, every time I go to Peru this place is a must! Even with the appearance of absolutely fabulous new and exciting restaurants, this place makes me feel I am at home. There is a reason why Peru is consistently among the very top of culinary destinations in the world! 
Always buzzing and a little loud, the place is fun and busy no matter what day of the week you go. The menu is a mix of Peruvian classics with splashes of new elements and “fusiones”. Drinks are always delicious. Service is quite good. This time I was lucky to try some of the dessert items with Chirimoya, a glorious and delicious fruit. 
One improvement point is the parking situation: very few spaces available and no valet parking. They don’t take reservations ( but that has always been the case).

reviews.title: Food was excellent!
reviews.text: Our Uber recommended La Mar as a good seafood restaurant. After she dropped us off at the restaurant we noticed immediately that this was going to be a great experience. It was crowded at 3pm when we got there but the atmosphere was pleasant. The hostess was nice and professional and the waiters, mostly men, were also very helpful and gracious. The food was excellent. We choose the crab and prawn patties and the shrimp cocktail for appetizer. For the main course I ordered whole Cabrilla fried fish and my husband had fish skewers. The prices were reasonable. I would definitely go back!

reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: We would have stayed here all day if we could have. Despite it being very crowded, we did not need to wait long for a table. The vibes are immaculate, every drink we tried was amazing, and all of the food was beyond delicious. Staff was friendly and accommodating. Definitely the best place for a ceviche lunch in Lima.

reviews.title: A MUST TRY
reviews.text: We made plans to try La Mar and absolutely made sure it happened. The restaurant doesn’t tKe reservations so be there BEFORE they open, the line fills fast and by 1:00 it’s a 2 hour wait. Get there before 12. They’re only open until 5/5:30 because they’re food is incredibly fresh. We tried their ceviche, muchame de fortuno and their shrimp with rice. All amazing and highly recommend the muchame de fortuno - easily the best meal we had our entire stay.

reviews.title: Fun restaurant with fresh, delicious dining!
reviews.text: Surprising, I was seated right away. This place is very busy, but so worth it, even if you have to wait. I went with fresh fish dishes--tuna tiradito and grilled prawns. My waiter, Ivan, was very attentive and friendly and gave excellent food/drink recommendations. I would love to come back to this place!

reviews.title: Bring patience and an empty stomach
reviews.text:
This is a very busy restaurant, so bring your patience and an empty stomach!  We were seated at the bar and it was fascinating to watch them mix the drinks. 
I don’t know if sitting at the bar is why our service was so poor, but our server would disappear for 15-20 minutes at a time. One of my friends only ordered soup and it took the longest to come out - a good 10-15 minutes after everyone else’s food.  

I ordered the scallops with rice and it was huge!!  We also ordered Pisco Sours and they were very strong.  I couldn’t finish mine but my friend did…lol!  At the end of our meal they were closing for the day, so you would think our server would quickly bring our check, but that was not the case. We had to wait 10-15 minutes just for our check.

reviews.title: Super!!
reviews.text: Super kind and friendly staff. The food was amazing and was presented nicely. They are fast and have good prices. Both tourists and locals go there, the atmosphere is really nice!
